metadata.clock: performance.now(), ns units derived from ms; no claim of ns resolution
metadata.method: Warm each exact API, adapt bounded iterations toward 3 ms, rotate call order, retain every paired sample. Fixture generation and output verification excluded from timings.
metadata.inference_scope: Whole row-major batches, including JS guards, copies and legacy result allocations; report ns/row plus batch latency.
metadata.calibration_scope: Raw public JSON fit+free and apply+returned string. Parsing/emission included; fixture construction and JS output parsing excluded.
metadata.setup_scope: One observed batch constructor per case, outside inference timings; no cold-start distribution.
